summary.content:
Today's selection covers 96 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 75 on Artificial Intelligence and 7 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Why the US midterms sparked an AI stock selloff
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Fake security tools on GitHub push backdoors and infostealers
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, The Verge, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 58 articles published in the last 24 hours
